subject: swap-dirty-worktree
tier_reason: Receiver will run the swap against the operator's live worktree (irreversible if wrong)

objective.goal: Make the hot-reload swap refuse when the target worktree has uncommitted changes.
objective.intent: No operator work may be lost; a refused swap is acceptable, a silent overwrite is not. Message wording may change without asking.
done_when: A dirty target produces a refusal and git status is unchanged
The full package suite is recorded as passing

constraints.text: Do not touch the launcher config.

constraints: Edit only the three files owned by lane W1.

claims.text: Refusal path for a dirty worktree is implemented in swap.py
claims.label: observed
claims.basis: Read the full diff of swap.py at 21:05Z; not executed.

claims.text: Unit tests for the refusal path pass
claims.label: verified

evidence.scope: one test file, not the package suite

claims.text: Behaviour with a locked index file is unchanged
claims.label: inferred
claims.basis: The code path was not touched and was not exercised.

claims.text: Windows path handling after a refusal
claims.label: unknown

not_done: Full package suite has not been run

risks.text: Refusal may be raised after the source is partly staged
risks.mitigation: Check ordering in swap.py lines 120-160 first.

unknowns: Whether the MCP proxy caches the old module path after a refused swap

contingencies.if: The rehearsal shows a partial stage
